title: mri_robust_register
description: Inverse consistent registration of two volumes using robust and standard cost functions.

movable_volume.description: Input movable volume to be aligned to target.
movable_volume.title: Movable Volume

output_registration.description: Output registration (transform from mov to dst).
output_registration.title: Output Registration

outlier_sensitivity.description: Set outlier sensitivity manually for robust cost functions. Higher values mean less sensitivity.
outlier_sensitivity.title: Outlier Sensitivity

satit.description: Auto-detect good sensitivity for robust cost functions.
satit.title: Automatic Sensitivity Detection

mapped_movable.description: Output image: movable mapped and resampled at destination.
mapped_movable.title: Mapped Movable

mapped_movable_hdr.description: Output image: movable aligned to destination (no resampling, only adjusting header vox2ras).
mapped_movable_hdr.title: Mapped Movable Header

weights.description: Output weights (outlier probabilities) in destination space (0=regular,1=outlier).
weights.title: Weights Output

oneminus_w.description: Weights (outlier) map will be inverted (0=outlier), as in earlier versions.
oneminus_w.title: Invert Weights Map

iscale_out.description: Output text file for iscale value.
iscale_out.title: Intensity Scale Output File

iscale_in.description: Initial input text file for iscale value.
iscale_in.title: Intensity Scale Input File

ixform.description: Use initial transform LTA on source.
ixform.title: Initial Transform File

ent_radius.description: With ROBENT: specify box radius for entropy computation.
ent_radius.title: Entropy Radius

ent_correction.description: With ROBENT: use better entropy computation that works on smaller boxes.
ent_correction.title: Entropy Correction

ent_ball.description: With ROBENT: use ball around voxel instead of box.
ent_ball.title: Entropy Ball

ent_mov.description: With ROBENT: write movable entropy image.
ent_mov.title: Entropy Movable File

powell_tolerance.description: With MI, NMI etc: set Powell tolerance.
powell_tolerance.title: Powell Tolerance

no_sym.description: Do not map to half way space.
no_sym.title: No Symmetry Mapping

maximum_iterations.description: Maximum number of iterations on each resolution.
maximum_iterations.title: Maximum Iterations

ent_dst.description: With ROBENT: write target entropy image.
ent_dst.title: Entropy Destination File

high_iter.description: Maximum number of iterations on highest resolution.
high_iter.title: High Iterations Max

eps_iteration.description: Stop iterations when transform update falls below specified RMS distance.
eps_iteration.title: EPS Iterations

max_size.description: Specify largest voxel dimension for gaussian pyramid.
max_size.title: Max Size

min_size.description: Specify smallest voxel dimension for gaussian pyramid.
min_size.title: Min Size

sub_sample.description: Subsample if dimension is greater than the specified value on all axes.
sub_sample.title: Subsample Dimension Limit

white_bg_mov.description: Assume white background in MOV for padding.
white_bg_mov.title: White Background Movable

white_bg_dst.description: Assume white background in DST for padding.
white_bg_dst.title: White Background Destination

uchar.description: Convert inputs to UCHAR with rescale and histogram cropping.
uchar.title: Convert to UCHAR

mask_mov.description: Mask movable image with mask file.
mask_mov.title: Mask Movable

mask_dst.description: Mask destination image with mask file.
mask_dst.title: Mask Destination

half_mov.description: Outputs half-way movable (resampled in halfway space).
half_mov.title: Half Movable

half_dst.description: Outputs half-way destination (resampled in halfway space).
half_dst.title: Half Destination

half_weights.description: Outputs half-way weights (resampled in halfway space).
half_weights.title: Half Weights

half_mov_lta.description: Outputs transform from movable to half-way space.
half_mov_lta.title: Half Movable LTA

half_dst_lta.description: Outputs transform from destination to half-way space.
half_dst_lta.title: Half Destination LTA
